case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Ek and Gade are cousins.
Wan was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan, Ek and Lek live in the west row.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Only Gade, Rin and Wan live in the south row of houses.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 10 pm.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Gade was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan was at the granary from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Lek had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Rin owns two goats and a lame mule.
Rin was seen at the shrine at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
Rin sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Wan's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Wan says it was lent out days ago.

messages.speaker: detective
messages.text:
Let's reason from the rules. [R1: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.] [E7: Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.] So the werewolf lives in the south row, and [E5: Only Gade, Rin and Wan live in the south row of houses.]

[E2: Wan was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.] With [R2: Confirmed alibis are reliable.], that clears Wan. Death was around midnight, so Rin's 9 pm shrine sighting [E13: Rin was seen at the shrine at 9 pm, laughing with friends.] doesn't cover it.

Gade has no alibi at all. Gade is the best-supported suspect.
ACCUSE: Gade

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Investigators found black river mud at the mill.
Fon was at the weaver's hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Lek owns two goats and a lame mule.
The baker was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Anan was at the bathhouse from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Mali says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
Tawan had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the orchard lane.
Lek's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Lek says it was lent out days ago.
The next morning, Anan was seen with muddy boots.
Nobody can say where Tawan was after 10 pm.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Kanya, Tawan and Mali live in the north row.
Kanya and Fon are cousins.
Lek was at the tavern from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Only Lek, Anan and Fon live in the east row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Dao was at the tavern from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Bua owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old mill path runs past only one row of houses: the east row.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Somchai was at the shrine from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Nok had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
Kanya was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Gade, Nok and Bua live in the west row.
The next morning, Somchai was seen with muddy boots.
Gade was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
In this village, red clay is found only along the old mill path.
Only Kanya, Somchai and Dao live in the east row of houses.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Nobody can say where Nok was after 10 pm.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The night watchman was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Somchai's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Lek was at the market hall from 8 pm until 1 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Bua was after 9 pm.
Ploy owns two goats and a lame mule.
Only Lek, Somchai and Fon live in the south row of houses.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Fon was seen at the forge at 8 pm, laughing with friends.
Ploy, Bua and Ek live in the west row.
Ploy had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Ek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
It rained lightly the evening before the murder.
Ploy was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Somchai was at the weaver's hall from 8 pm until 1 am; the blacksmith confirms it.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Tawan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Bua was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Wan, Anan and Lek live in the north row.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
The old herbalist was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Ploy was at the weaver's hall from 7 pm until 10 pm; the priest confirms it.
Nobody can say where Anan was after 10 pm.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
Tawan was at the granary from 10 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
The next morning, Bua was seen with muddy boots.
Lek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Wan was at the tavern from 9 pm until 3 am; the priest confirms it.
Anan had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Only Ploy, Tawan and Bua live in the south row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the baker was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Nobody can say where Rin was after 11 pm.
The baker had planned to visit the city next week.
Only Tawan, Fon and Somchai live in the south row of houses.
Nok says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Fon owns two goats and a lame mule.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the south row of houses.
Tawan was seen at the market hall at 10 pm, laughing with friends.
Chai was at the weaver's hall from 10 pm until 4 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Chai had argued loudly with the baker that afternoon.
The baker was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Somchai was at the forge from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Somchai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Somchai says it was lent out days ago.
Fon was at the shrine from 10 pm until 4 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Chai, Rin and Nok live in the west row.

Somchai was [E12: at the forge from 11 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it], and [R2: Confirmed alibis are reliable]. That clears Somchai, lantern or not. Tawan's only sighting is [E8: Tawan was seen at the market hall at 10 pm], three hours before the death.

That leaves Fon, who has no confirmed alibi for 1 am. Tawan, please explain ... (cut: over word limit)
ACCUSE: Fon

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Gade was at the granary from 8 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Mali sells bread at the market on weekdays.
In this village, black river mud is found only along the hill track.
Anan was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The next morning, Gade was seen with muddy boots.
Mali, Kanya and Tawan live in the east row.
Gade's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Gade says it was lent out days ago.
Kanya had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
The hill track runs past only one row of houses: the south row.
Tawan says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Mali was at the forge from 9 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
Nobody can say where Kanya was after 9 pm.
Ploy was at the market hall from 6 pm until 9 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Only Anan, Gade and Ploy live in the south row of houses.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Tawan owns two goats and a lame mule.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge.

case.summary: Last night the miller was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: The miller had planned to visit the city next week.
Mali was at the shrine from 9 pm until 3 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Dao was seen at the granary at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Mali had argued loudly with the miller that afternoon.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 10 pm.
Investigators found white chalk dust at the well, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.
Only Dao, Gade and Chai live in the east row of houses.
Mali, Somchai and Bua live in the west row.
Bua says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Gade was at the market hall from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Chai was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The miller was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Chai's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Chai says it was lent out days ago.

case.summary: Last night the night watchman was murdered at the mill. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Dao, Ek and Anan live in the north row of houses.
Investigators found red clay at the mill.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Kanya says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Dao and Kanya are cousins.
Anan's lantern was found near the mill the next morning; Anan says it was lent out days ago.
The orchard lane runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Rin had argued loudly with the night watchman that afternoon.
Fon was at the market hall from 11 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Anan was at the shrine from 11 pm until 3 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The night watchman was found dead at the mill. The healer says death happened around 1 am.
Ek was at the granary from 8 pm until 11 pm; three neighbours confirm it.
Fon sells bread at the market on weekdays.
Fon, Rin and Kanya live in the west row.
Nobody can say where Rin was after 11 pm.
The next morning, Anan was seen with muddy boots.
Dao was at the forge from 10 pm until 4 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
In this village, red clay is found only along the orchard lane.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the river bridge. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Bua's lantern was found near the river bridge the next morning; Bua says it was lent out days ago.
Bua was at the bathhouse from 10 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
The chapel bell rang at 9 pm, as it does every night.
Kanya owns two goats and a lame mule.
Ek says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.
Only Bua, Kanya and Mali live in the east row of houses.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
The old herbalist was found dead at the river bridge. The healer says death happened around midnight.
Kanya was at the market hall from 9 pm until 2 am; the priest confirms it.
Mali was seen at the tavern at 9 pm, laughing with friends.
Nobody can say where Somchai was after 10 pm.
Chai, Somchai and Ek live in the north row.
Chai was at the weaver's hall from 9 pm until 3 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Chai had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Investigators found black river mud at the river bridge, and a trail leading toward the east row of houses.

case.summary: Last night the old herbalist was murdered at the well. One of the villagers listed below is a werewolf who did it.

rules.text: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.
Confirmed alibis are reliable.

evidence.text: Only Rin, Bua and Kanya live in the north row of houses.
Ploy was at the bathhouse from 8 pm until 2 am; three neighbours confirm it.
Nobody can say where Ek was after 9 pm.
Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.
Investigators found red clay at the well.
In this village, red clay is found only along the reed path.
The next morning, Kanya was seen with muddy boots.
The old herbalist was found dead at the well. The healer says death happened around 11 pm.
Ek had argued loudly with the old herbalist that afternoon.
Ploy, Ek and Fon live in the south row.
Rin was at the weaver's hall from 6 pm until 9 pm; the blacksmith confirms it.
Ek sells bread at the market on weekdays.
The rope of the well was replaced last spring.
Bua was at the shrine from 8 pm until 2 am; the blacksmith confirms it.
The reed path runs past only one row of houses: the north row.
Kanya's lantern was found near the well the next morning; Kanya says it was lent out days ago.
Ploy owns two goats and a lame mule.
Fon says they were home asleep all night; nobody can confirm it.

[R1: After the murder, the werewolf went straight home.] So the werewolf lives in the north row. [E1: Only Rin, Bua and Kanya live in the north row of houses.]

Kanya has a confirmed alibi. [E4: Kanya was at the forge from 9 pm until 1 am; the innkeeper confirms it.] [R2: Confirmed alibis are reliable.] Death was around 11 pm, so that clears Kanya.

That leaves Rin and Bua. Rin's confirmed time ends at 9 ... (cut: over word limit)
ACCUSE: Bua

- **S3.7:** Fon says E14 is the only thing pointing away from Rin. It actually points toward Rin, because it clears Bua.
